title: Expose bounded background test-run rescan trace discovery without registration correlation
outcome: Operators can discover recent background rescan operation IDs and their existing lock-phase timing records from a bounded read-only diagnostic response, without manufacturing a test registration or reading the live store.
acceptance: A bounded metadata-only diagnostic read enumerates recent background rescan trace IDs, operation IDs, server instance and existing phase marks without requiring a run registration or a previously known random operation ID; existing exact filters remain available.

Trace discovery preserves bounded storage/output and reset/truncation semantics, exposes no session content or test logs, and changes no admission, state authority, persistence, verification or test execution behavior.

Deterministic tests cover idle background rescan discoverability, limits/filtering, and restart/epoch qualification. The lifecycle heartbeat item is cross-linked as a consumer of StateInner diagnostic evidence.
